notes: ACCOUNT POSITION. Contract value QAR 29,000.00. The 75% advance of QAR 21,750.00 is received in full by this receipt. Balance QAR 7,250.00 — 20% QAR 5,800.00 on delivery of materials at site, and 5% QAR 1,450.00 after successful testing, commissioning and handover.

Received with thanks. The advance being settled in full, material is now on order and the programme commences from this date: material delivery 3 to 5 days, site mobilisation within 3 working days of material arrival, installation 7 to 10 working days on a civil-ready site, and testing and commissioning 1 working day thereafter.

SITE READINESS. Please ensure the room position is clear, level and accessible, and that the power supply and the cable run from the main distribution board to the cold room control panel are available, as these are by others under our quotation. The installation period assumes a civil-ready site.

SITE SURVEY. Final room dimensions will be confirmed on site before fabrication. Any change arising will be advised to you in writing, with its effect on the price and the programme, before the work is done.
This receipt is issued against INV-287/2026 and is subject to the terms of our approved quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ121/2026 (Revised).
